title: Warrior two

steps.text: Stand with your feet wide apart.
steps.cue: Stand with your feet wide apart.

steps.text: Turn the front foot out and bend that knee over the ankle.
steps.cue: Front foot out. Bend that knee over the ankle.

steps.text: Stretch your arms out at shoulder height.
Keep your torso upright and look over the front hand.
steps.cue: Torso upright. Look over the front hand.

steps.text: Hold for a few breaths, then straighten the leg and change sides.
steps.cue: Hold and breathe, then straighten the leg.
steps.say: Hold for a few breaths, then straighten the leg.

mistakes: Letting the front knee cave inward.
Leaning the torso over the front leg.
stopIf: Come out if your front knee hurts.

anatomy.why: The front thigh holds the bent knee steady while the inner thighs lengthen.
